note: The chat-app track of Answers Over Time: the owner asks each app BY HAND and imports the replies from a file (cli archive-chatbot-template, cli archive-chatbot-import). No software ever contacts these apps. The ids below refer to locked questions in archive_questions.json and archive_trending.json; the text and the exact prompt come from there. Until the first real import the ten may be changed; after it, ids may only be added. Names are used only to say which app was asked; this project is not affiliated with their makers.
